name: Muroto (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Muroto city emblem in white: a ring with four small points enclosing a stylised triangle.
history: Municipal flag of Muroto, a city in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1959.

features.role: Muroto city emblem — a ring with four small points enclosing a stylised triangle
